one_liner_zh: 再生元營收年增19%但 EPS 6.75 美元大幅低於預期21.5%，Eylea 競爭與成本壓力拖累獲利。
one_liner_en: Regeneron grew revenue 19% but EPS of $6.75 missed badly by 21.5%, with Eylea competition and costs hitting earnings.
beat_or_miss: 低於預期：EPS 大幅低於預期 21.54%，惟營收年增 19.04% 維持成長。
ai_view_zh: 訊號偏弱：營收成長雖維持雙位數，但 EPS 大幅低於預期，反映 Eylea 競爭加劇與成本上升正侵蝕獲利。短期股價可能因獲利不如預期承壓。中期關鍵在 Dupixent 持續放量、Eylea HD 能否抵禦競爭與生物相似藥、以及腫瘤管線（如 Libtayo、雙抗）能否成為新成長引擎。約15倍本益比已反映部分疑慮，催化劑在臨床數據。
ai_view_en: Signal is weak: double-digit revenue growth persists, but the large EPS miss reflects intensifying Eylea competition and rising costs eroding earnings. Near term the stock may be pressured by the shortfall. Mid term, the keys are continued Dupixent ramp, whether Eylea HD defends against competition and biosimilars, and whether the oncology pipeline (Libtayo, bispecifics) becomes a new growth engine. A ~15x P/E reflects some concern; catalysts lie in clinical data.
highlights_zh: 營收 36.1 億美元，年增 19.04%，產品組合擴張
Dupixent 合作收入與新適應症持續貢獻
Eylea HD 高劑量版本爭取市場份額
研發管線（腫瘤、免疫）布局深厚
highlights_en: Revenue of $3.61B grew 19.04% on portfolio expansion
Dupixent collaboration revenue and new indications contribute
Eylea HD high-dose version competes for share
Deep R&D pipeline in oncology and immunology
risks_zh: EPS 大幅低於預期，獲利能見度受損
Eylea 面臨生物相似藥與 Vabysmo 競爭，營收侵蝕
研發支出高企壓抑短期利潤率
risks_en: Large EPS miss damages earnings visibility
Eylea faces biosimilar and Vabysmo competition eroding revenue
High R&D spend pressures near-term margins
